Piano transcription model (Studio's transcription model, transcription-v1.onnx)
===============================================================================

Not part of this repository and not bundled in the app: the app downloads it on
demand, from this project's GitHub release "models", when someone chooses
Download on the Studio page, and checks its SHA-256 before it is used.

Source:  "High-resolution Piano Transcription with Pedals by Regressing Onsets
         and Offsets Times", trained model (Note_pedal, CRNN_note_F1=0.9677,
         pedal_F1=0.9186) by Qiuqiang Kong, Bochen Li, Xuchen Song, Yuan Wan
         and Yuxuan Wang (ByteDance). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4034264

Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0),
         https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (the licence's text is
         at that address; CC BY 4.0 section 3(a)(1)(C) allows the address in
         place of the text).

Changes: converted from PyTorch to ONNX, and its fully connected layers
         (the fc5 matrix multiplications and the output heads) quantised to
         INT8 per channel, for Steven Piano; the convolutions, the GRUs and the
         spectrogram front end stay float. The conversion is
         tools/studio/export_transcription.py, documented in
         docs/STUDIO_SPIKE.md. No weights were retrained.

The model keeps its own licence; the MIT licence of this project does not apply
to it. The model was trained by its authors on the MAESTRO dataset; the licence
above is the one its authors published for the weights. The app credits it in
About ("Studio models: ByteDance piano transcription (CC BY 4.0) ...") and in
AUTHORS.
